videos.description: Meet Judah. 🦁 Every strong build starts with a strong foundation — and every strong team needs a heart. So we gave ours a face. Judah is the official mascot of LeLei Develop. He stands for the three things we don’t compromise on: strength in our work-ethics, Faith in God (Yeshua) and what we’re doing, also having Pride in the country we do it in. He’s got our name on his chest and the flag right beside it. That’s not decoration. That’s the standard. Welcome to the team, Judah. Let’s build something that lasts. 🇺🇸✝️ #LeLeiDevelop #Judah #LionOfJudah #NewMascot #StrengthFaithCountry
